newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 15.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Health and Welfare Minister Junichiro Koizumi hints at delaying starting age for pensions beyond 65.
-- Share of corporate bonds underwritten by Nomura Securities Co Ltd falls sharply.
-- Science and Technology Agency to accuse officials of Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corporation (PNC) as early as Wednesday of making false report on nuclear plant fire.
-- Finance Ministry to conduct nationwide questionnaire in bid to cut subsidies to local governments.
-- Japan and South Korea agree to promote security dialogue.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) will not cooperate with Social Democratic Party (SDP) in next year's Upper House election.
-- Metropolitan government forced to repay 280 million yen in emergency loans for 12 small firms over cancellation of "World City Expo".
